verdict.rationale: Numeral ships several built-in automated triggers—nexus-crossing alerts, autofile/autoregister, automatic certificate validation and expiration monitoring—that fire actions on events (docs-33, docs-34, docs-13, docs-32). However, there is no evidence of a general-purpose rules/conditions engine that lets an AI-native user *define* custom triggers or logic; the automations are fixed, vendor-defined behaviors rather than user-configurable event rules. Missing for 10: user-definable trigger conditions/webhooks, a rules DSL or API for custom event-action mapping, and any example of a customer authoring their own automation rule.
